cfd.horizon_note: The case was live at capture (guard time 0.307382809573 s); only complete .100/.150/.200/.250 native checkpoints are compared. No later CFD time is used.

scalar_sources.external_water: volIntegrate(alpha.water) over externalAirZone; reported separately from line water
scalar_sources.pressure: point probe p at (1.25,-0.55,1.60) and (1.25,0.55,1.60) m; these are local probes, not volume-weighted headspace means
scalar_sources.seat_flux: sum(alphaPhi0.water) over native valveSeatA1/A2/B1/B2 faceZones; the configured face-zone normal points +x
scalar_sources.seat_pressure: areaAverage(p,p_rgh) over those same native valve seat faceZones; p is absolute

additional_model_limitations: The direct compact CAD centerline changes both branches' elevation/profile from the preserved legacy x-only packet; no measured path was available.

The 1-D integrated full line volume is about 2.08% above the native Tank A full line-zone volume; the initial wet-prefix area integral is about 0.634% above the separately measured native feed inventory. Neither value was rescaled.
The 1-D geometric inertance integrals are model profile values; the native mesh does not provide a matching centerline integral of ds/A, so no native inertance equality is claimed.
Current CFD uses zero-thickness lamella walls; gross area is retained, while the reduced profile does not add their wetted perimeter to friction.

The isothermal limit predicts earlier outlet arrival and materially different pressure/withdrawal than n=gamma. This is a model heat-transfer assumption sensitivity, not a fitted exponent or measured heat transfer.
Halving dt leaves first outlet arrival and crown-stop time nearly unchanged for this explicit ODE; this is time-step sensitivity only, not validation of full-bore front kinematics.

Air front pressure remains the ambient-pressure approximation. The dry-path air screen is incomplete because no air minor-loss K is supplied; its low early Mach diagnostic does not establish late-time gas-pressure uniformity.
The run stops at the highest intake-crown condition; it does not represent full tank emptying or validated gas ingestion.
geometry_and_initial_state_gaps.line_profile_note: Model is one representative tank/two-branch compact centerline; it is compared separately with each CFD tank. The centerline/inertance and transition/friction profile are provisional and not an exact native mesh path match.

interpretation.flow: For each CFD tank, the two native valve-seat alphaPhi0.water face-zone sums are added to give total two-branch flow; the reported CFD Q is the mean of those per-tank totals, not mean individual-branch flow. These native fluxes are exact saved scalar samples, not sampled mouth-plane interpolation Q.
interpretation.outlet: Model first outlet-water arrival is ~0.6170 s lower / ~0.6252 s upper for n=gamma and ~0.5846 s lower / ~0.5915 s upper for n=1. The n=1 arm arrives earlier; both arms remain later than this 0.10-0.25 s comparison window. The model is a provisional filling analysis, not a validated front predictor.
interpretation.pressure: Reduced-model bulk tank pressure is compared with local CFD headspace point probes. CFD tank/line/external inventories and native seat flux/pressure are exact function-object rows at each native checkpoint. Printed probe p/T histories are linearly interpolated between rows spaced about 0.25 ms apart because their timestamp text is less precise; each target is within about 4 ns of the upper row. No volume-weighted CFD headspace pressure was computed from full fields.
interpretation.scope: early line-filling prefix only; not outlet-discharge validation or a formal mesh/physics comparison
interpretation.state: Both CFD tanks are reported separately; reduced model is a one-tank representative. Differences may include line-profile/initial-feed geometry, solver/interface behavior, and model closure; no parameter is fitted.

reduced_model.limitation: The n=gamma and n=1 curves are assumptions/sensitivities in the existing reduced model, not measured thermal bounds or validation envelopes.
reduced_model.model_scope: current compact 1-tank / 2-branch equivalent line, downstream air, wetted feed through assumed valve plane
reduced_model.sampling: Linear interpolation bracketed by saved model-history rows at each exact CFD checkpoint time; no extrapolation/fitting.
